name: 1Password
description: 1Password is a unified access management platform, described by the vendor as "the most trusted vault for identities, credentials, and secrets," securing credentials and secrets for humans, AI agents, and machines.
best_for: Positioned for organizations — from individual users to large enterprises — that need to manage access, credentials, and secrets across complex environments, including human and machine/AI-agent identities.

alternatives.name: Bitwarden
alternatives.description: An open-source, end-to-end encrypted password manager that also secures passkeys and secrets for people, AI agents, and machines.
alternatives.best_for: Individuals, families, and businesses wanting an open-source password manager with self-hosting options.

alternatives.name: LastPass
alternatives.description: A zero-knowledge-encryption password manager and vault for logins and account information.
alternatives.best_for: Individuals, families (up to 6), small teams, and MSPs needing shared password management.
